prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A cinematic, wide-angle shot set in a modest classroom with warm, natural lighting streaming in from the left, casting soft shadows and creating a gentle, inviting atmosphere. Two men stand at the front of the room, positioned in front of large whiteboards mounted on a wooden-paneled wall. The man on the left is younger, with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a bright blue long-sleeve shirt and dark trousers, his posture upright and attentive as he looks toward the older man. The older man, standing to the right, has short gray hair and wears a loose, striped button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up, paired with dark pants. He holds a marker in his right hand and faces the younger man, his expression engaged and slightly inquisitive, as if in the midst of a thoughtful exchange.

The whiteboards behind them are mostly clean, with minimal Arabic writing in black marker—one board has a single word, while the other displays a short phrase underlined at the top. Above the boards, colorful educational posters and anatomical diagrams add subtle visual interest and context, hinting at a science or language lesson. The lower part of the wall is clad in aged wood, contributing to the classroom’s humble, lived-in feel.

The color palette is dominated by earthy browns, soft whites, and the striking blue of the younger man’s shirt, with the overall tone balanced and natural. The composition is symmetrical, with both men centered and framed by the boards, creating a sense of focus and intimacy. The camera is positioned at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the two men sharply in focus while gently blurring the background details, emphasizing their interaction. The mood is contemplative and authentic, evoking a moment of learning, mentorship, or dialogue in a real-world educational setting.
